property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the DataMergeOption (a Application or Document).

property.name: fittingOption
property.shortdesc: Instructions for fitting content in a frame.

property.name: centerImage
property.shortdesc: If true, centers the image in the frame; preserves the frame size as well as content size and proportions. Note: If the content is larger than the frame, content around the edges is obscured by the bounding box of the frame. This doesn't work with fittingOption CONTENT_AWARE_FIT

property.name: linkImages
property.shortdesc: If true, links images to the target document. If false, embeds images in the target document.

property.name: removeBlankLines
property.shortdesc: If true, removes blank lines caused by empty fields.

property.name: createNewDocument
property.shortdesc: If true, creates a new document when records are merged.

property.name: documentSize
property.shortdesc: The maximum number of pages per document.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the DataMergeOption.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
